title: Warmly Spiced American Beef Bowl
description: A savory and nostalgic American dish featuring red chilli powder and ferment, served in a Korean brass bowl, with a low-glycemic-friendly twist.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large skillet, heat the sesame oil over medium-high heat.
Add the ground beef and cook until browned, breaking it up into small pieces as it cooks.
Add the red chilli powder, coconut aminos, salt, and black pepper to the skillet and stir to combine.
Add the chopped kimchi to the skillet and stir to combine.
Transfer the skillet contents to a Korean brass bowl.
Top the beef mixture with cauliflower rice and green onions.
Bake the bowl in the preheated oven for 20 minutes.
Remove the bowl from the oven and let it cool for 5 minutes before serving.
Cook ground beef to an internal temperature of 71°C / 160°F (no longer pink in the middle) before serving.
